body: Built adapters/ftp (jlaffaye/ftp, pool, staged STOR+rename, FTPS, tested against ftpserverlib in-process), adapters/webdav (net/http only, staged PUT+MOVE, tested against x/net/webdav), adapters/sqlblob (sqlb table, per-engine upsert, substr ranged reads, CAS, conditional write; SQLite + Postgres verified, MySQL not yet run). Conformance passes on all three; deps guards, redaction tests, break-verified tests. Guides docs/adapters/{ftp,webdav,sqlblob}.md, module READMEs, examples adapters-{ftp,webdav,sqlblob} (verified in a scratch module). Pending with coordinator: MODULES, test:engines for sqlblob, examples/go.mod requires+replaces.
